m2.title: Arena returns
m2.action: Hard cut from the room to the arena. Dain's arena background, wizard left, wolf right, at the exact Scene 2 start positions. Wolf settles into idle; wizard raises the staff. Full arcade color in one frame, no fade.
m2.camera: Fixed wide, identical crop to Scene 2 frame 2.01
m2.sound: Arena music resumes loud mid-phrase; the fan cuts dead
m2.control: Move, attack, dodge and block available; connection still unstable
m2.note: v0.3 Scene 6: the arcade colors return, the music is loud again, the ghost is no longer visible.

m2.title: One inner line, varies by what you saw
alts: Badge seen: Isn't her break almost over?
Phone seen: She still hasn't answered her mom.
Food seen: She's probably laughing with her mouth full of rice again.
m2.action: Fighters idle. One narration line fades in along the bottom of the arena in the player's inner voice, then fades out before the first exchange. Exactly one line plays, chosen from the objects the player actually observed.
m2.camera: Fixed wide; no portrait, no cutaway to the room
m2.sound: Music continues under the line; no sting
m2.duration: Line visible 1.6 s, 0.3 s fade each side
m2.control: Not a prompt; player keeps control the whole time
m2.note: Exact v0.3 narration lines. Evidence of imagining a person, not moral prompts.

m2.title: Lia lands a hit
m2.action: Wizard fires the cyan spell rightward (Dain's leah-effect sprite). It connects; the wolf is pushed 40 px right and flinches, feet still on the platform. A chat line pops top-right while the match keeps going.
m2.sound: Spell hiss, hit thud, one chat ping
m2.duration: Spell travel 0.3 s, flinch 0.2 s, chat stays 1.5 s
m2.control: Player can still act; mid-match chat is read-only
m2.note: v0.3: Lia lands a hit. lia_ph: bro just block 😭

m2.title: You try to block, late
m2.action: Player presses block. The wolf's guard (gray shield slab in front of it) appears 0.4 s after the press, after the second spell has already passed. NETWORK DELAY flashes once in the top band; the wizard keeps moving.
m2.sound: Button press, then a delayed guard clack after the hit
m2.control: Input accepted, resolved late; the world never pauses
m2.note: Same NETWORK DELAY device as Scene 2; v0.3 shows no millisecond number here.

m2.title: Knocked off the platform
m2.action: The wizard's follow-up launches the wolf right and up past the platform edge, rotated 20 degrees, beyond the arena border. DEFEAT drops in over the arena after 0.3 s; the wizard returns to idle on the left.
m2.duration: Launch 0.5 s, result hold until advance
m2.note: v0.3: Your character gets knocked off the platform. DEFEAT.

m2.title: ez, and the same two replies
m2.action: MATCH CHAT slides up over the frozen result. lia_ph: ez. The two reply buttons appear with the 00:03 timer, pixel-identical to Scene 2: okay that was clean / fuck off. Nothing on screen marks either one.
m2.camera: Same chat crop and scale as Scene 2 frame 2.07
m2.sound: Chat ping; the timer ticks each second
m2.duration: 3 s window; timeout counts as silence
m2.control: One tap on either button, or let the clock run
m2.note: v0.3: the same three-second response returns. Carl: identical pair at the opening and the end so the comparison survives; wording approved 2026-10-31.

m2.title: ALTERNATIVE A: give her credit
m2.chat:
you: okay that was clean
lia_ph: wait weren't you here earlier
m2.action: Your line appears; her reply lands 0.8 s later. Nothing else changes: no apology, no warmer tone. The result stays frozen behind the chat.
m2.duration: Reply after 0.8 s; hold until advance
m2.note: v0.3 reply to a compliment in the second match: wait weren't you here earlier.

m2.title: ALTERNATIVE B: lash out
m2.chat:
you: fuck off
lia_ph: HAHAHA still mad
m2.action: Your line appears; her reply lands 0.8 s later. She does not escalate; she is amused. Result stays frozen behind.
m2.duration: Reply after 0.8 s; hold until advance
m2.note: v0.3 reply to an insult in the second match: HAHAHA still mad.

m2.title: ALTERNATIVE C: say nothing
m2.action: The timer reaches 00:00; the reply box greys out and closes. No message from Lia this time; the chat simply ends. The result stays on screen for one quiet second.
m2.control: No input; recorded as said nothing
m2.note: v0.3: if they remain silent, the conversation simply ends. Lia doesn't apologize.

m2.title: Disconnect: the screen folds inward
m2.overlay:
CONNECTION LOST
RECONNECTING TO HOST: lia_ph
m2.action: The arena image creases down the middle and folds inward toward the center like paper closing, taking the chat with it. No crack and no thrown controller this time. The fold ends in a thin vertical line of light.
m2.camera: Fixed wide; the fold happens inside the frame
m2.sound: Music pitches down and stops; soft suction, far quieter than the first pull
m2.duration: Fold 0.9 s, line of light 0.4 s
m2.note: v0.3 Scene 7: the match disconnects again; the screen folds inward. Same faulty-connection rule, no new portal mythology.

v2.title: Gentle fall through the monitor
v2.action: Instead of the first chaotic pull, the ghost drifts down out of Lia's monitor like a leaf: two slow S-curves, then it settles beside the plastic chair. The ghost is Dain's wolf sprite at 55 percent opacity with no legs; the finished ghost form replaces it later.
v2.camera: Starts on the dark monitor, widens as the ghost descends
v2.sound: The fan returns first, then room tone. No laughter this time
v2.note: v0.3: the ghost now falls gently through the monitor. 2:31 AM. Locale is Lapu-Lapu City per Carl's revision; the source says Quezon City.

v2.title: Same room, same framing, four changes
v2.action: Exact first-visit wide framing. Only four things differ: the game is minimized and the monitor shows the work app; Lia wears the work headset; the chair is 18 px closer to the desk; she sits upright with both feet down. Nothing else has moved.
v2.camera: Fixed wide, identical to the first arrival card R.1
v2.control: Ghost can float; observe is available but nothing new highlights
v2.note: SANABI direction 6: repeat the camera position on visit two; posture changes the meaning before any camera move.

v2.title: She straightens her shirt and breathes
v2.action: Medium crop over the desk. Lia tugs the T-shirt hem flat with her free hand, rolls her shoulders back once, inhales (chest rises 2 px), exhales. The ghost floats behind her chair, a little lower than before.
v2.note: v0.3: She straightens her shirt. She takes a breath.

v2.title: STATUS: AVAILABLE
v2.action: One click. The work app status flips from AFTER BREAK to AVAILABLE. Her hand returns to rest beside the keyboard. Hold on the word.
v2.note: v0.3: The work application displays STATUS: AVAILABLE.

v2.title: A call connects
v2.action: The app chimes and a call panel opens. Her face changes: the smug and laughing expressions from the first visit are replaced by a polite neutral set (small portrait box, top-left). Shoulders square up.
v2.note: v0.3: A call connects. Her expression changes.

v2.title: Thank you for calling
v2.speech: Thank you for calling. My name is Lia. How may I help you today?
v2.action: The camera pushes toward her over 1.2 s while she says the line. Posture upright and still, headset mic at her mouth. The ghost still floats behind her, now half out of frame.
v2.sound: The warm gaming music fades to nothing; her professional voice only
v2.duration: 1.2 s push, hold on the line
v2.note: v0.3 Scene 7 closing line. The person who was laughing at you a minute ago now sounds completely different.

c1.title: Ghost beside the monitor
c1.action: Close side view over the desk. The ghost floats beside the monitor, muzzle toward Lia, touching nothing. Her small portrait (top-left) smiles politely. Keys move.
c1.sound: Faint caller voice through the headset; keys
c1.control: Observe only; player may hover near the monitor
c1.note: v0.3 Scene 8: not about reading a tragedy; the player witnesses Lia trying to do her job.

c1.title: The customer opens
c1.customer: I was told this would be fixed yesterday.
c1.action: The customer's line appears in a box on the monitor's left edge with a small speaker mark: heard through the headset, never spoken on screen. Lia's portrait keeps the polite smile; her typing hand pauses.

c1.title: Let me check the status
c1.speech: I'm sorry about the delay, sir. Let me check the status for you.
c1.action: Balloon above Lia. She types: two small key marks every 0.3 s; the app shows a checking bar. Her shoulders stay square.

c1.title: Are you even listening?
c1.speech: Yes, sir. I'm checking the latest update.
c1.action: A few seconds pass with only typing. The customer's line arrives; she answers without looking up from the screen.

c1.title: Her hands stop
c1.customer: Then why does nobody there know what they're doing?
c1.action: Close insert of her hands: they stop above the keyboard for half a second, fingers slightly curled, then resume. No face shown.
c1.camera: Cut to hands insert, cut back
c1.sound: Caller line, then the keys fall silent
c1.note: v0.3 SANABI staging: briefly show her hands stopping over the keyboard.

c1.title: I understand why you're frustrated
c1.action: She says it evenly, eyes on the screen, portrait unchanged. No lean, no sigh.
c1.note: This is the line the final chat is compared against: ez versus I understand why you're frustrated.

c1.title: Transfer
c1.customer: Can I speak to somebody else?
c1.speech: Of course. Before I transfer you, I can confirm the refund is still processing. I'm sorry I couldn't resolve it today.
c1.action: She clicks transfer; the app shows TRANSFERRING then TRANSFER COMPLETE and the call panel closes.

c1.title: The app goes quiet
c1.action: The work app becomes quiet. Lia sits motionless for three seconds. Hold a close-up on her tired eyes: lids half lowered, no tears, no music.
c1.camera: Slow push from close to very close over 1.5 s, then hold
c1.note: v0.3 SANABI staging: after the call ends, hold a close-up on her tired eyes.

c1.title: If shouting made refunds faster
c1.speech: Sir, if shouting made refunds faster, I'd be shouting with you.
c1.action: She says it to the dead call, then pulls a face at the monitor: tongue out, eyes crossed, 0.4 s.
c1.sound: Her voice, a small chair creak

c1.title: Kana. Customer empathy.
c1.action: She flicks a hand at the monitor as if presenting a dish, then drops it.
c1.note: Cebuano draft adaptation of v0.3 Ayan. Customer empathy. (there, that's customer empathy). Carl to tune.

c1.monitor:
QA EVALUATION — PREVIOUS CALL
EMPATHY / TONE — NEEDS IMPROVEMENT

c1.title: What she could have said
c1.monitor:
COACHING NOTES
Confirm the customer's concern before explaining the process.

c1.note: v0.3: no dramatic breakdown; she reviews what she could have said differently.

c1.action: Cut back to the wide room. The ghost floats silently beside her; the work app shows AFTER-CALL WORK; nothing in the room has moved.
